import os,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
import re
G=load()
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # find box
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x==5 for x in g[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c]==5 for r in range(H))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    # non-zero non-5 markers
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    L=[m for m in marks if m[1]<c0]; R=[m for m in marks if m[1]>c1]
    lc=L[0][2]; rc=R[0][2]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    rm=(r0+r1)//2; cm=(c0+c1)//2
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if r<rm: out[r][c]= lc if c<cm else rc
            else: out[r][c]= rc if c<cm else lc
    return out

print(json.dumps(transform(G['Test input'])))
